faq_lists.title: What services does Aximuscode provide?
faq_lists.content: Aximuscode provides digital, AI, software, design, marketing, and business management solutions.

faq_lists.title: Can Aximuscode handle complete digital projects?
faq_lists.content: Yes, we provide end-to-end solutions from planning and development to launch and support.

faq_lists.title: Do you work with startups and established businesses?
faq_lists.content: Yes, we work with startups, small businesses, and established companies.

faq_lists.title: Can you create customized solutions for my business?
faq_lists.content: Yes, our solutions are tailored to your specific goals, requirements, and industry.

faq_lists.title: Do you provide AI-powered solutions?
faq_lists.content: Yes, we offer AI solutions that help businesses automate processes and improve efficiency.

faq_lists.title: Do you provide ongoing support after project completion?
faq_lists.content: Yes, we offer maintenance, updates, optimization, and ongoing technical support.

faq_lists.title: How can I get started with Aximuscode?
faq_lists.content: Simply contact our team and share your requirements. We’ll guide you through the next steps.

faq_lists.title: What career opportunities are available at Aximuscode?
faq_lists.content: We offer opportunities across development, design, AI, digital marketing, management, and other technology roles.

faq_lists.title: How can I apply for a position at Aximuscode?
faq_lists.content: You can contact our team or submit your CV through our careers channel when positions are available.

faq_lists.title: Does Aximuscode offer internships?
faq_lists.content: Yes, internship opportunities may be available for students and fresh professionals.

faq_lists.title: Can fresh graduates apply for jobs?
faq_lists.content: Yes, we welcome talented fresh graduates for suitable entry-level opportunities.

faq_lists.title: What skills do you look for in candidates?
faq_lists.content: We value technical expertise, creativity, communication, problem-solving, and a willingness to learn.

faq_lists.title: Are remote or flexible positions available?
faq_lists.content: Depending on the role, we may offer remote, hybrid, or flexible working opportunities.

faq_lists.title: Can I submit my CV for future opportunities?
faq_lists.content: Yes, you can share your CV with us so our team can consider you for suitable future openings.

faq_lists.title: How much do Aximuscode services cost?
faq_lists.content: Pricing depends on the service, project scope, complexity, and required features.

faq_lists.title: Do you offer customized packages?
faq_lists.content: Yes, we create flexible packages based on your business needs and budget.

faq_lists.title: Can I request a free consultation?
faq_lists.content: Yes, you can contact our team to discuss your requirements and receive initial guidance.

faq_lists.title: Do you offer monthly service plans?
faq_lists.content: Yes, monthly plans can be available for selected digital, AI, marketing, and management services.

faq_lists.title: Can I upgrade my plan later?
faq_lists.content: Yes, your plan can be adjusted as your business needs and requirements grow.

faq_lists.title: Do you provide project-based pricing?
faq_lists.content: Yes, we offer project-based pricing for specific development, design, AI, and digital projects.

faq_lists.title: What is included in your service plans?
faq_lists.content: Each plan includes different services and deliverables based on the selected package and project requirements.
